crossRefs.note: Joshua blessed him; and he gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.
to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and its pasture lands around it;

parallels.note: but the fields of the city, and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

people.name: Caleb
people.line: Faithful spy, given Hebron as inheritance

people.name: Jephunneh
people.line: The Kenizzite, father of Caleb the spy.

translations.web: But they gave the fields of the city and its villages to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.
translations.bsb: But they had given the fields and villages around the city to Caleb son of Jephunneh as his possession.
translations.kjv: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.
translations.asv: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.
